plugins.name: interface-design
plugins.description: Craft-first design for dashboards, admin panels and tools. Extracts patterns from existing code and audits against them.

plugins.name: dashboard-design
plugins.description: Clean dashboards: KPI tiles, charts, comparison periods, empty states, plus a screenshot QA pass.

plugins.name: ux-audit
plugins.description: UX anti-pattern audit (interface-auditor) and flow checklists (flow-checker) from uxuiprinciples. Works without an API key, with less detail.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Vercel's UI review: 100+ accessibility, UX and design rules, reported as file:line findings.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Plan-before-code design with curated anti-patterns (/impeccable shape, critique, polish). Use instead of frontend-design for new projects.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Searchable library of styles, palettes, font pairings and UX rules. For new projects; in existing ones use only its UX review.

plugins.name: ui-animation
plugins.description: UI motion: springs, gestures, scroll effects. Optional, for motion-heavy work.

plugins.name: playwright-eyes
plugins.description: Playwright MCP plus a skill that makes Claude screenshot and critique its own UI before calling it done.
